statusLegend.VERIFIED: Fact asserted with an inspected source, hash and exact locator.
statusLegend.HISTORICAL_ASSERTION: Value communicated historically in the corpus. Provenance only; not an executable contract and not a substitute for a real mandate.
statusLegend.MISSING: No real value exists in the inspected material. Documented with reason, inspected sources, custodian role and next retrieval action.
statusLegend.SYNTHETIC_EXAMPLE: Explicitly fabricated example used only to exercise the verifier. Never accepted evidence.
